_comment: Increases beach biome size by flattening continentalness within a band around the beach center using the formula y = x - clamp(x + a, -w, w), with 'a' being the negated beach center (default 0.15) and 'w' being the half-width of the flattened band (default 0.08). Inputs in [-a-w, -a+w] all collapse to -a, so terrain across that whole band shares one Y level (flat beaches). To make beaches bigger just increase 'w' (ex: 0.12 for ~3x the band width), and the opposite to shrink them. Note: values of 'w' larger than ~0.16 may erase deep_ocean or inland biomes adjacent to the beach band.
